outcome.technical:
WHAT CHANGED. plugins/audit/scripts/governance/_clause_coverage.py. (1) CONSERVATION, built into the reading: _read_body now works on spans of the description, so acceptance_reading returns itemSpans and leftOut ([{kind, line, start, end, text}] - the text before the first item, the body of a marker not read, the text from a heading that ended the body) and region; _unaccounted subtracts marker spans [cut, body start), opener spans, item spans and left-out spans from the region [first marker's cut, end) and returns the non-whitespace remainder as unaccounted (empty for every committed description and every generated one; is_plain is false when it is not, and the line names it). (2) NO SILENT DEPARTURE, three scans of the description independent of the reading: mentions (_MARKER_WORD, any case, spaces before the colon, ASCII or full-width colon, at every place not counted - fences and backticks included), strayNumbers (_stray_numbers: inside an item, a (n) not glued to a word in a parenthesised list, a line-start number at the list's indent in a line-numbered one, either at any indent in unnumbered text; fenced ones skipped) and openFence. _departures adds one clause each, with count and first instance quoted (the instance's line from that point). describe_reading prints nothing only for is_plain AND no departure; a reading with no item prints 'no clause was read; ...' when the marker word occurs (a counted marker with no text says 'the marker on line N is followed by no text'). The 'other shape' note stays silent on an otherwise plain reading (cr6e, a parenthesised item with Markdown sub-steps) and is said on any printed line. (3) The corrections: _markers counts a sentence-opening marker only when no marker was counted before it (a marker inside a body ends it only when it opens a line); _PAREN_NUMBER is (?<![\w)\]}])\((\d{1,6})\); _layout reads CommonMark fences (opening run of 3+ backticks or tildes indented at most three spaces, a backtick run whose info string holds a backtick is no fence; closing run of the same character at least as long with only spaces or tabs after it; unclosed runs to the end and is reported by line). (4) Bounded cost: line numbers and fence membership by bisect; the line-opener test is memoised per line and the sentence test reads backwards from the marker, so neither re-reads a line per marker (the unchanged reader took 32 s on ten thousand markers on one line; now the hostile table runs 0.02-0.60 s per input over two runs about fifteen minutes apart, the second under load; cq13 bounds each at 10 s). reading_summary keeps exactly {shape, items, line} and stays None for a description with no item (audit-task.py's _acceptance_key promises no key then, so the JSON form does not carry the 'no clause was read' line - the human line does). Module docstring: a WHAT THE AUTHOR IS TOLD paragraph; acceptance_reading's docstring states CONSERVATION and the scans.

TESTS. tests/test__clause_coverage.py, new blocks after the existing ones (cq-measured, cq-conserve, cq-correct, cq-hostile): cq1-cq7 are (a)-(g) of the description, each the exact input measured; cq8 the conservation case over 3 list bodies x 11 disturbances = 33 generated descriptions (9 built to print nothing), the expectation (items, parts left out, the clauses owed, quiet) built from the segments and the subtraction counted off the generated text, never off the reader's spans, plus the reader's own remainder asserted empty; cq9 correction 1 with its paragraph twin; cq10 correction 2 with the glued twin (letter, underscore, digit, closing bracket - and that list prints nothing); cq11 correction 3 (inline span, longer backtick and tilde fences, text after a closing fence, an info string, an unclosed fence named); cq12 the quiet plain lists (own lines, one paragraph after a sentence, exit(1), rows[0](2), bold marker, the suite's DESCRIPTION); cq13 hostile inputs (empty, None, 42, a list, a dict, only the marker, marker at the end, ten thousand line markers / markers on one line / mentions / fences, a megabyte list of 90000 items, a megabyte line) - each returns a reading and a line within 10 s; cq14 the backtick mention, beside a real marker and alone; cq15 the remainder clause and its quiet twin. The suite: ALL PASS: 71/71 cases passed.

EXISTING CASES CHANGED ON PURPOSE (all in tests/test__clause_coverage.py): cr2 asserted reading_line == '' for the marker in backticks and in a quotation; it now asserts the same empty reading AND a line saying no clause was read and naming the mention. cr3 asserted 'marker' not in the line for a marker inside a fence after the real list; it now asserts 'Acceptance markers' not in the line (no second marker counted) and that the line names '1 mention of the marker word not read as a marker, first "Acceptance: none"' - the property says the word anywhere not counted is reported, fences included. cs9b asserted DESCRIPTION, an empty marker 'Acceptance:  ' and no marker all print ''; DESCRIPTION and no marker still print '', the empty marker now prints a line starting 'acceptance: no clause was read' (the property: a marker word that yields no item says so).
